findings.publisher: Florida Department of Health in Walton County
findings.title: DOH-Walton Offices Close in Response to Severe Weather Impacts
findings.exact_supporting_passage: All DOH-Walton offices will close Thursday, October 8, in response to the severe weather impacts. Offices will remain closed until further notice.
findings.summary: The Florida Department of Health in Walton County states all county health offices closed October 8 until further notice because of severe weather. The county health department provides WIC services, so in-person WIC appointments and benefit issuance may be interrupted October 8-9. The notice does not establish an outage for existing WIC EBT purchases. This signal is newly found in the supplementary watch, but the notice is dated October 8 and its publication hour is unknown; it cannot be certified as first published during the observation window.
affected_groups: WIC applicants needing in-person eligibility/benefit services

bounded_query_context.temporal_qualification: Newly discovered during this recall watch, not proved newly posted or newly effective within the hourly search window.

classes_checked: abrupt food pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
duplicates_excluded: previously signaled Escambia, Santa Rosa, Okaloosa, Bay, Washington (Florida) and George/Jackson (Mississippi) WIC office closures
stale_results_excluded: El Paso TX September food-bank storm closure
San Jose CA threatened Lighthouse Food Rescue closure (no confirmed new immediate service cessation)
observation_limitations: Latest prior completed watch end only known to approximately 22:47 PT October 8; this run started at 00:43 PT October 9.
Walton County notice is dated October 8 without published hour; this is a newly discovered missed signal, not a confirmed new event within the hourly observation window.
No reported WIC EBT purchase outage. In-person impact inferred from all-offices closure and confirmed WIC service listing.
